name: Matching Pennies
description: 2-player, 2-strategy zero-sum game. No pure NE; unique mixed NE at (1/2, 1/2).
source: Osborne & Rubinstein (1994). A Course in Game Theory, pp. 17-18.

mixedNashProfiles.derivation: Indifference: P2 mixes so P1 is indifferent: 1*q + (-1)*(1-q) = (-1)*q + 1*(1-q) → 2q-1 = 1-2q → q=0.5. Symmetric for p.

notes: Zero-sum: utilities[0] + utilities[1] = 0 at every profile.
Win-Stay Lose-Shift converges to (0.5, 0.5) in repeated play (Camerer 2003).
